description: List captured requests as summaries, oldest first. Without "after" you get the most recent ones; with "after" you page forward from that request id. Use get_request for headers and body. Does not move wait_for_request's position.

after.description: Only requests after this request id (e.g. "req_12"), or "start" for the very first.

inbox_key.description: The inbox_key returned by create_inbox (starts with "porch_sk_").

method.description: Only requests with this HTTP method, e.g. "POST".

path_prefix.description: Only requests whose path (after the inbox URL) starts with this, e.g. "/stripe".

name: list_requests

has_more.description: With "after": more requests follow. Without: older requests exist.

next_after.description: Pass as "after" to get the next page.

approval_choice.description: Set when this request answered an approval link.

id.description: Request id, e.g. "req_3". Use it with get_request or as a cursor ("after").

path.description: Path after the inbox URL, e.g. "/stripe".

title: List requests
